outcome: Grave maternal complications (HELLP syndrome, pulmonary edema, coagulopathy, postpartum collapse, eclampsia)
cohort: The study included 100 antenatal women diagnosed with mild preeclampsia.
finding: Both Tablet Labetalol and Tablet Nifedipine were equally efficacious in controlling hypertension in mild preeclampsia, although Tablet Nifedipine was associated with a significantly higher number of side effects.
gest_age: The majority of babies were term (≥37 weeks gestation), with deliveries generally targeted at 37 completed weeks gestation or earlier if severe preeclampsia developed.
